scope: Compiled native-shared browser UI and real isolated SQLite API. Actual credential verification, sign-in, rejected sign-in and logout requests create the report history; no historic login rows are seeded.

transportBridge.scope: Only pinned discovery and virtual API transport are redirected to owned loopback connections; production TCP pooling is not certified.

checks: A fresh database reports one actual sign-in and explicit reporting/active-account coverage, without invented historic events.
All five real account types contribute activity; Club Admin/Manager/Player/Spectator have no entry point or API data; rejected credentials stay unattributed.
Real club/team creation and invitation acceptance prove event-time access scope, multi-team non-additivity and safe exclusion of unattributed failures.
A real UI sign-out and fresh Super Admin sign-in occur between completed phases; session revocation, credential verification and all role checks remain required.
Actual dashboard controls request club/team/range/role/outcome filters, reset incompatible teams, and page real history without duplicates when new events arrive.
Phone320/390 and tablet1024 layouts fit without horizontal overflow and the actual trend exposes an accessible text summary.
